plugins.name: maestro-career-studio
plugins.description: Drive Maestro Career Studio from your assistant: capture and score jobs, tailor resumes against a JD, render PDFs, and track applications. Requires the stack running locally (docker compose up -d) — the server talks to your own backend and nothing leaves the machine.
